title: Vavezi veMatombo veMupata Wekare
intro: Fungidzira budiriro yakasimuka mumipata ine matombo yeArabia, ine hunyanzvi hwekuveza dzimba dzakanaka kubva mumakomo. Vakabudirira nesimba uye neunyanzvi, asi nyaya yavo inoratidzwa nekusateerera yambiro yaMwari kunotyisa. Sezvaunonyatsoongorora nyaya yavo, uchaona vanhu vane kuzvikudza kwakaita kuti vaparadzwe zvachose. Vaiva vanaani?
clues: Takagara nhaka nyika ine matombo nemawere marefu, kwatakavaka dzimba dzedu nehunyanzvi husina muganho.
Taizivikanwa nekugadzira dzimba dzakachengeteka mumakomo, tichinzwa takachengeteka kubva pakukuvadzwa kupi zvako.
Mutumwa akauya kwatiri achibva pakati pedu, achitiyeuchidza nezvenyasha dzaAllah uye achitinyevera nezvechirango.
Takakumbira chiratidzo, ngamera hadzi inoshamisa ikabuda mudombo, bvunzo yakajeka kubva kuna Allah.
Takateerera yambiro tikagura makumbo engamera diki, tichiseka mutumwa uye tichipikisa chirango.
Kubhomba kamwe chete kwakatibata mudzimba dzedu, uye mangwanani takarara pasi, sekunge hatina kumbobvira tagara imomo.
verse: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]. (69:5)
